svg.title: A shop's layers
svg.desc: Bilibin's item shop asking "What would you like?", as the player sees it, comes apart into the six sheets the console stacks to draw it, then closes again. The room keeps the map's three layers: the floor and walls on BG3, the counter, shelves and furniture on BG2 with the people as sprites level with it, and a glow of light on BG1, blended over the room. Every window is on BG0, the one layer they share, and what is drawn into them all at once, the Herb's name and price, the coins and the description, is tiles of that layer too. In front are sprites: the letters of the shopkeeper's question, typed one by one, his portrait, the item icons and the pointing hand.
